children: Menē Inc. (TSX-V: MENE) (US: MENEF) (“Menē” or the “Company”), today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. All amounts are expressed in Canadian dollars unless otherwise noted. The Company also announced that Vincent Gladu, President & Chief Executive Officer, will transition out of his role at Menē. He will stay on until April 2, 2027 to ensure a smooth leadership transition.
IFRS Revenue of $6.1 million, an increase of $0.2 million (3%) year-over-year (“YoY”).
Gross profit of $1.5 million, with a gross profit margin of 25%, a decrease of $0.2 million YoY.
Net loss of $0.02 million for the quarter, compared to net income of $0.06 million in Q3 2025.
Total metal weight of 30 kilograms sold during the quarter, consisting of 2,671 units of jewelry.
Introduced 18 new product designs throughout the quarter.
Sales to returning customers accounted for 70% of total sales for the quarter.
Featured in Financial Times HTSI, The Rake, The Blend, Man About Town and Something About Rocks, among others.
Registered over 48,000 independent customer reviews with an average rating of 4.9 out of 5 on mene.com/reviews since inception.

Statement from CEO Vincent Gladu on the Third Quarter 2026

Revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were $6.1 million, an increase of $0.2 million, or 3% year-over-year (“YoY”). Net Sales1 decreased 3% YoY, with average order value increasing 17% YoY, partially offsetting an 18% decline in orders and a 13% decline in new customer acquisitions. Importantly, while the rate of decline in orders has remained stable month-over-month (“MoM”) during the quarter, the rate of decline in new customer acquisitions, while still negative, has materially improved MoM over the same period. While accurate customer attribution remains a challenge, we believe this improvement to be a result of the tactics we have implemented to address this trend over the past year. We continue to monitor and proactively address progress on these important metrics.

In mid-July, we soft-launched the Menē Pure Silver Summer Capsule, our first collection in a new precious metal since the Company’s inception. Originally intended as a limited collection of 99.9% pure silver jewelry, these products were designed to be purchased primarily for their craftsmanship, aesthetic appeal, and connection to the Menē brand2. Pure silver also allows us to launch entirely new product designs that are too difficult to produce in pure gold or platinum. Following a successful initial launch, we expanded the collection in late September to include some of our most popular chain and bracelet models, alongside some new styles such as the Wide Rounded Box Chain, a bold take on one of our best-selling designs. We intend to expand pure silver into a broader, full-fledged collection that will grow over time. Expect some exciting surprises on the product side in Q4 and beyond.

While the launch of Pure Silver was a material endeavour for us, Q3 also saw the successful completion of several smaller projects that were planned to be delivered this year and that bring continuous improvement and refinement to our operations, ensuring that our customer experience only improves over time.

As we head into our busiest season of the year, planning for 2027 is well under way. Our brand refresh efforts, which are central to our growth strategy in the coming years, are now our key focus. The Company is still young and, while strong foundations have been laid to support what comes next, much territory remains to be explored and mastered. While our growth strategy demands that we now make bolder moves and take more, albeit still calculated, risks, our long-term objective remains unchanged: To build Menē into an enduring company and brand distinguished by exceptional craftsmanship, thoughtful design, and outstanding customer service.
Net Sales is calculated as gross sales less discounts and returns.
Menē Pure silver jewelry is sold at a fixed price, not by weight, and is not “investment jewelry”. It is also not eligible for Menē’s Lifetime Buyback Guarantee.

The Company announced today that Vincent Gladu, President & Chief Executive Officer, will transition out of his role at Menē. He will stay on until April 2, 2027 to ensure a smooth leadership transition.

“On behalf of the Board, I wish to thank Vincent for the significant achievements and results he has achieved during his tenure at Menē” said Roy Sebag, Founder and Executive Chairman of the Board. “He leaves the Company in a strong financial and operational position, and we are grateful for his commitment to a smooth handover.”

“Leading Menē has been a privilege, and I am proud of what our team has accomplished in the past 3.5 years,” said Mr. Gladu. “The Company is now debt free, profitable and well capitalized, with a strong and lean operational foundation on which to grow. I look forward to leading the company through April 2, 2027, while supporting the transition to a new CEO to lead the Company into the future."
The Board will be initiating a search for a successor, considering both internal and external candidates and will provide an update in due course.

Non-IFRS Adjusted Revenue is a non-IFRS measure. The Company adjusts its revenue by adding back the value of jewelry returned by customers, revenue from orders not yet delivered, and discounts given to customers. These adjustments are made to assess gross revenue before deducting these items per IFRS. The closest comparable IFRS measure is revenue.

Adjusted EBITDA is calculated as total operating income (loss), excluding depreciation and amortization, stock-based compensation, income taxes, interest and other non-recurring expenses. The closest comparable IFRS measure is total operating income (loss).

Menē crafts pure 24 karat gold, 999 platinum and 999 silver jewelry. Gold and platinum jewelry is transparently sold by gram weight, while silver jewelry is sold at a fixed price. Through mene.com, customers may purchase jewelry, monitor the value of their collection over time, and sell or exchange their pieces by gram weight at prevailing market prices. Menē was founded by Roy Sebag and Diana Widmaier-Picasso with a mission to restore the relationship between jewelry and savings. Menē empowers consumers by combining innovative technology, timeless design, and pure precious metals to create pieces that endure as a store of value.
For more information about Menē, visit mene.com.
